training.method: Validation-only class routing between existing Shift-trained heads; no additional gradient training

source_visible_training.method: Shift visible-food linear head on frozen SigLIP; whole-image inputs, no masks at inference
source_visible_training.selection: Highest validation micro F1; existing minimum 5 predictions and 85% validation precision per-class rule
source_visible_training.seconds_scope: Loading and head fitting; streamed frozen feature extraction is separate

training.selection: Existing 85% validation precision / 5 predictions floor, then maximum per-class validation F1

source_balanced_training.selection: Maximum validation micro F1, ties to smaller head; no test selection
source_balanced_training.source_features: Same pinned full-image frozen SigLIP; no masks needed at inference

same_images_shared_categories.comparison: Both heads, same JPEGs, pinned original thresholds; narrow old labels mapped to containing coarse category; egg types unioned
